people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

translations.web: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
translations.bsb: Have him stand before Eleazar the priest and the whole congregation, and commission him in their sight.
translations.kjv: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
translations.asv: and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
